integrity: Analytic substitution proves the weak-wave claim; the included symbolic script is a reproducibility check. No independent audit or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification is restricted to profiles U(xi)=max(1-exp(lambda xi),0).
The result does not prove uniqueness among all sharp fronts, nonexistence at other speeds, or stability.
The literature search was bounded and does not prove exhaustive novelty.
title: An exact sharp-front speed curve for a degenerate reaction–diffusion–advection equation
